name: Verdurous-Cwm
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by a binary sunset, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, dark crystals alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
